The '''15th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] for [[1957 in film|1957]] films, were held on February 22, 1958.

==Film==

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Drama|Best Film - Drama]]===
''' ''[[The Bridge on the River Kwai]]'''''
*''[[Wild Is the Wind (1957 film)|Wild is the Wind]]'' 
*''[[Sayonara (1957 film)|Sayonara]]''
*''[[12 Angry Men (1957 film)|12 Angry Men]]'' 
*''[[Witness for the Prosecution (1957 film)|Witness for the Prosecution]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy|Best Film - Comedy or Musical]]===
''' ''[[Les Girls]]'''''
*''[[Don't Go Near the Water (film)|Don't Go Near the Water]]''
*''[[Love in the Afternoon (1957 film)|Love in the Afternoon]]''
*''[[Pal Joey (film)|Pal Joey]]''
*''[[Silk Stockings (1957 film)|Silk Stockings]]''

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama|Best Actor - Drama]]===
'' '''[[Alec Guinness]] - [[The Bridge on the River Kwai]]'''''
*''[[Marlon Brando]] - [[Sayonara (1957 film)|Sayonara]]''
*''[[Henry Fonda]] - [[12 Angry Men (1957 film)|12 Angry Men]]''
*''[[Anthony Franciosa]] - [[A Hatful of Rain]]''
*''[[Charles Laughton]] - [[Witness for the Prosecution (1957 film)|Witness for the Prosecution]]''

'''[[Joanne Woodward]] - ''[[The Three Faces of Eve]]'''''

*''[[Anna Magnani]] - [[Wild Is the Wind (1957 film)|Wild Is the Wind]]''
